en: Black-and-white postcard showing a street lined with heavily damaged and burned buildings after a major fire. Ruined arches and walls stand on the left, while more intact multi‑story buildings are on the right. A few people walk along the cobbled street. Printed captions in French and English at the bottom describe the scene as related to the great fire of Salonica (Thessaloniki) in August 1917.
